SPOON_CARD_SET_STS1_ONLY.title: Slay the Spire 1 Cards
SPOON_CARD_SET_STS1_ONLY.description: Rewards, shops and card generation offer Slay the Spire 1 cards instead of Slay the Spire 2 ones. So far only the Ironclad has them; other characters keep their own cards.
SPOON_SPIRE_SOUVENIR_MODIFIER.title: Spire Souvenir
SPOON_SPIRE_SOUVENIR_MODIFIER.descriptio: Every character with Slay the Spire 1 cards starts with the Spire Souvenir: their rewards, shops and card generation mix Slay the Spire 1 and Slay the Spire 2 cards. So far the Ironclad and the Silent have Slay the Spire 1 cards. A card that plays differently in each game comes as either version; card rewards let you switch.
SPOON_NEOW_BLESSING.title: Neow's Blessings
SPOON_NEOW_BLESSING.description: Neow offers its usual blessings, as in a Standard run, even with other modifiers. Modifiers that bring their own Neow option (Draft, Sealed Deck…) offer it first.
